en.heroTitle: Vermicompost for Apple Orchards — Usage, Timing & Bulk Supply
en.heroLead: Premium vermicompost for apple growers: improve soil organic matter, root-zone health, moisture retention, and nutrient availability. Satva supplies 50 kg bags and bulk for orchards across Himachal Pradesh, Jammu & Kashmir, and other apple belts.

sectionsBeforeTable.title: Why Apple Orchards Need Organic Soil Care
paragraphs: Many apple blocks suffer from tired, acidic soil and years of chemical-heavy programmes. Vermicompost adds stable organic matter and beneficial biology that helps unlock nutrients and improve water holding on slopes.
Satva’s enriched formula includes Trichoderma, Azotobacter, PSB, and botanical extracts suited to orchard root zones. Results depend on tree age, spacing, and soil test—always adapt doses locally.

faqs.question: When is the best time to apply in apple orchards?
faqs.answer: April–May before active growth is the most common window. A lighter post-harvest application can help restore organic matter before dormancy.

faqs.question: Can I mix vermicompost with chemical fertiliser?
faqs.answer: Yes, but keep a gap of several days if applying fungicides or strong chemicals the same week—you want to protect the microbes you added.

faqs.question: Do you deliver to upper hill districts?
faqs.answer: Yes. Freight and MOQ for remote districts are discussed on enquiry via WhatsApp or phone.

paragraphs: कई बागान थकी, अम्लीय मिट्टी और रासायनिक कार्यक्रमों से प्रभावित हैं। वर्मीकम्पोस्ट स्थिर जैविक पदार्थ और लाभकारी जीव जोड़ता है।

faqs.question: सबसे अच्छा समय?
faqs.answer: अप्रैल–मई सक्रिय वृद्धि से पहले। फसल के बाद हल्का अनुप्रयोग भी मदद कर सकता है।

faqs.question: रासायनिक उर्वरक के साथ?
faqs.answer: हाँ, लेकिन फंगिसाइड/तेज़ रसायन से कुछ दिन का अंतर रखें।

faqs.question: ऊपरी पहाड़ी जिलों में डिलीवरी?
faqs.answer: हाँ। दूरस्थ जिलों के लिए फ्रेट पूछताछ पर।
